title: Scout Runtime Execution Result
description: Defines the final runtime ledger for a Scout execution. An Execution Result consolidates the execution outcome, objective completion, deliverables, produced runtime objects, step results, quality decisions, approvals, exceptions, statistics, resource usage, publication readiness, learning candidates, memory outcomes, trace data, and recommended next actions.
